_comment: Project Access Control policy for Crystals on UGS Economy (docs/runbooks/economy-setup.md). Players may read Economy but never change it; Cloud Code (service token) is not a Player principal, so the CrystalWallet/Spend/Grant functions still work. Blocked requests return HTTP 403 with code 56. Apply per environment: PATCH https://services.api.unity.com/access/v1/projects/{projectId}/environments/{environmentId}/resource-policy with this body minus _comment.
